title: Funds for One Love Festival
lastAction: Ref to the Com on Appropriations, if favorable, Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
aiSummary: This bill appropriates $250,000 in state funds for the 2025-2026 fiscal year to The Arts Council, Inc. to support the 1Love Festival, a three-day cultural event in Winston-Salem featuring music, arts, and entertainment designed to celebrate diversity and foster unity.
aiProArguments: Supporters argue this funding supports cultural expression and community engagement by providing resources for a festival that celebrates diversity and brings people together. They contend that arts and cultural events provide economic benefits to local communities, create jobs, and enhance quality of life for residents.
aiConArguments: Opponents may question whether state general funds should be used for individual local events when other priorities compete for limited resources, and whether a one-time $250,000 appropriation sets a precedent for other communities to request similar directed grants. They might also argue that local governments or private sponsorship could fund the festival instead of using state taxpayer dollars.
